sentiment.reason_en: Market sentiment is positive today, with S&P 500 up 0.50% and VIX down 8.60% to 16.16. Weak DXY (-0.20%) and declining oil prices (-2.46%) support a risk-on environment. However, the US-Iran conflict continues to weigh on markets with a bearish impact.

market_impact_summary.en: Equity markets are up, with S&P 500 +0.50% and STOXX 600 +0.59%. TLT is stable (-0.06%) and US 10Y yield up (+0.54%) to 4.48%. Oil is down (-2.46%) to $81.12 and gold up (+0.87%) to $4365.80. DXY is weak (-0.20%) at 99.54.

audio_script_it:
Buongiorno, benvenuti al Morning Briefing di Price Alert.

Il Nikkei ha chiuso in rialzo del 5.13%, Shanghai in rialzo dell'1.5%. Questo suggerisce un'apertura positiva per i mercati europei.

L'S&P 500 ha chiuso in rialzo dello 0.5%, il VIX è in calo dell'8.6%, segnale di propensione al rischio. Il Dollar Index è in calo dello 0.2%, mentre l'oro è in rialzo dello 0.87% a $4365.8 l'oncia. Il petrolio è in calo del 2.46% a $81.12 Il rendimento del decennale americano è in rialzo dello 0.54% al 4.48%, mentre il BTP 10Y è stabile al 3.82%.

La Banca del Giappone ha alzato i tassi di interesse in risposta ai rischi di inflazione. Inoltre, Bruxelles e Pechino sono ai ferri corti sul fronte commerciale, con la Cina pronta a rispondere a eventuali mosse protezionistiche dell'UE.

Nessun dato macro rilevante in uscita oggi.

Passiamo ora al comparto degli asset digitali. 
  Bitcoin si apprezza dell'uno virgola trentacinque percento, arrivando a sessantaseimila cinquecentosessantacinque dollari. 
  I flussi netti nei fondi ETF sono stati positivi per due virgola otto milioni di dollari. 
  Questo movimento potrebbe essere influenzato dalla recente dichiarazione di Michael Saylor, secondo cui Bitcoin non necessita di yield simili a quelli di Ethereum.

  Tra le altcoin, Ethereum guadagna il quattro virgola tredici percento, arrivando a mille settecentonovantacinque dollari. 
  Solana registra un aumento del quattro virgola novantasei percento, a settantaquattro virgola novantaquattro dollari. 
  BNB invece mostra una crescita modesta dello zero virgola zero nove percento, arrivando a seicentoquattordici virgola ottantasei dollari.

  Il Fear & Greed Index è a ventitré, in zona di Extreme Fear, il che suggerisce cautela sugli investitori.

Nessun dato macro in agenda oggi. Per approfondire i temi di oggi, sulla nostra piattaforma trovate gli articoli completi nella sezione Storie in Primo Piano. Grazie per l'attenzione e a domani.
audio_script_en: Good morning, welcome to the Price Alert Morning Briefing. The Nikkei closed up 5.13%, Shanghai up 1.5%. This suggests a positive opening for European markets. The S&P 500 closed up 0.5%, the VIX is down 8.6%, a sign of risk appetite. The Dollar Index is down 0.2%, while gold is up 0.87% to $4365.8 per ounce. Oil is down 2.46% to $81.12 The 10-year US yield is up 0.54% to 4.48%, while the 10Y BTP is stable at 3.82%. The Bank of Japan raised interest rates in response to inflation risks. Additionally, Brussels and Beijing are at odds on the commercial front, with China ready to respond to any protectionist moves by the EU. No major macroeconomic data out today. Let's pivot to the cryptocurrency markets... Bitcoin appreciates by 1.35%, reaching $66,565 Net flows into ETF funds were positive for $2.8 million. This move could be influenced by Michael Saylor's recent statement that Bitcoin does not need yields similar to Ethereum's. Among altcoins, Ethereum gains 4.13%, reaching $1,795 Solana registers an increase of 4.96%, to $74.94 BNB shows modest growth of 0.09%, reaching $614.86 The Fear & Greed Index is at 23, in Extreme Fear territory, suggesting investor caution. No macroeconomic data on the agenda today. For a deeper dive into today's topics, find the full articles in the Top Stories section on our platform. Thanks for your attention, and we'll see you tomorrow.

articles.title: Ukraine's fiscal and financial challenges
articles.snippet: As it faces the exigencies of an existential war, Ukraine is confronted with stark fiscal and financial policy trade-offs, despite the mitigation provided by large-scale external financial support. So far, its authorities have kept monetary and financial stability under control beyond a relatively brief initial episode of turmoil in 2022. What is the broad fiscal equation for Ukraine looking forward, taking into account uncertainties about European funding beyond 2027? Can domestic revenue be raised? articles.title: Taking geopolitically motivated US swap lines too far would harm the dollar and Fed independence
articles.snippet: Over the past century, the United States has provided dollar liquidity abroad through both the US Treasury and the Federal Reserve, but the appropriate mode of liquidity injection depends on the economic, financial, and geopolitical contexts. The Treasury is the more appropriate lending conduit when geopolitical concerns dominate, while Fed dollar provision should primarily be targeted toward global stability objectives and be more insulated from short-term foreign policy motives. Up to now, political abuses of these foreign lending channels have been constrained to some degree by laws, norms…
